strata.allocation: source-family clusters are assigned round-robin across the 12 domain-by-model strata; every base_scenario_id belongs to exactly one source family and one frozen model profile

paired_semantic_generator.interpretation: with the stated probability one latent paired semantic outcome is shared within a source-family cluster; otherwise paired outcomes are independently drawn within that cluster. Marginal p11/p10/p01/p00 are calibrated per stratum.

failure_generator.stratum_failure_rate: arm base probability multiplied by domain failure_multiplier and model failure_multiplier
failure_generator.scoring: all generated failures set the affected arm publication_composite_correctness to 0; failures never remove a base_scenario_id from the analysis denominator
failure_generator.calibration: latent semantic treatment accuracy is solved per stratum so expected FINAL post-failure treatment-minus-control accuracy equals the target final_delta for that stratum

clustering.cluster_size_rule: contiguous clusters of size 8 plus one final remainder cluster when N is not divisible by 8
clustering.primary_variance: CR1 source-family cluster robust sandwich for intercept-only paired differences

power_search.selection_rule: smallest candidate N on the frozen grid at or above 802 whose one-sided 95% Wilson lower confidence bound for JOINT HOLDOUT+REPLICATION success is at least 0.90

confirmatory_success_simulation.HOLDOUT: independent draw; estimate > 0 and two-sided CR1 Student-t p < 0.05
confirmatory_success_simulation.REPLICATION: independent draw from the same frozen population generator; estimate > 0; its two-sided p-value and interval are recorded but significance is not required for replication success
confirmatory_success_simulation.joint: HOLDOUT success AND REPLICATION success in the same Monte-Carlo replicate

type_I_calibration.acceptance: one-sided 95% Wilson upper confidence bound for two-sided false-positive probability must be <= 0.055

sensitivity.required_reporting: rerun the frozen generator at the selected R2 N for all three delta values; only 0.08 drives the primary sample-size selection

explicit_nonclaims: the generator is a fitted stochastic model of future benchmark outcomes
the heterogeneity or failure parameters are empirically estimated from HOLDOUT or REPLICATION
the R2 selected N is final before independent statistical review and accepted WP-004/WP-005/WP-007 dependencies
Monte-Carlo replicates are benchmark sample units
